howto.name: Choose encode or decode mode
howto.text: Select whether you want to encode data to Base64 or decode a Base64 string back to its original form.

howto.name: Enter input
howto.text: Paste text into the editor; any language works, because text is encoded as UTF-8. For decoding, paste the Base64 string.

howto.name: Get the result
howto.text: The output appears instantly. Copy it to your clipboard, or use Swap sides to run it back the other way.

faq.q: Can I encode files (not just text)?
faq.a: No. This tool encodes and decodes text only; there is no file upload, and Base64 that holds binary data such as an image cannot be decoded to text here.

faq.q: Is there a size limit for encoding?
faq.a: There is no fixed limit; everything runs in your browser, so very long text is limited only by your device. Keep in mind that Base64 output is approximately 33% larger than the original.
Standard Base64 (RFC 4648) using A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, and /. URL-safe Base64 (with - and _ in place of + and /) is not supported.
